title: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
subtitle: Trening za CKA (Kubernetes v1.35): lekcije po zvaničnom CNCF kurikulumu, labovi na pravom kubeadm klasteru (controlplane + node01) bez interneta, zadaci kao na ispitu i teorijska provjera znanja.

exam.note: Pravi CKA ispit je praktičan (oko 16 zadataka u terminalu za 2 sata, prolaz 66%). Ova simulacija provjerava teoriju; praktični dio je modul „Probni ispit“ (17 zadataka u terminalu, 120 minuta).
exam.note_en: The real CKA exam is hands-on (about 16 terminal tasks in 2 hours, 66% to pass). This simulation tests theory; the practical part is the "Mock exam" module (17 terminal tasks, 120 minutes).

objectives.en: Manage role based access control (RBAC)
Prepare underlying infrastructure for installing a Kubernetes cluster
Create and manage Kubernetes clusters using kubeadm
objectives.bs: Kreiranje i upravljanje klasterom pomoću kubeadm-a

objectives.en: Manage the lifecycle of Kubernetes clusters
Implement and configure a highly-available control plane
Use Helm and Kustomize to install cluster components
objectives.bs: Helm i Kustomize za instalaciju komponenti

objectives.en: Understand extension interfaces (CNI, CSI, CRI, etc.)
Understand CRDs, install and configure operators
Understand application deployments and how to perform rolling update and rollbacks
Use ConfigMaps and Secrets to configure applications
objectives.bs: ConfigMap i Secret za konfiguraciju aplikacija

objectives.en: Configure workload autoscaling
Understand the primitives used to create robust, self-healing, application deployments
objectives.bs: Primitivi za otporne i samoizlječive aplikacije

objectives.en: Configure Pod admission and scheduling (limits, node affinity, etc.)
Understand connectivity between Pods
Define and enforce Network Policies
Use ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer service types and endpoints
Use the Gateway API to manage Ingress traffic
Know how to use Ingress controllers and Ingress resources
Understand and use CoreDNS
Implement storage classes and dynamic volume provisioning
Configure volume types, access modes and reclaim policies
objectives.bs: Tipovi volumena, access modes i reclaim policy

objectives.en: Manage persistent volumes and persistent volume claims
Troubleshoot clusters and nodes
Troubleshoot cluster components
Monitor cluster and application resource usage
Manage and evaluate container output streams
Troubleshoot services and networking

sources.title: Killer Shell simulator (2 sesije uz kupljen ispit)
sources.title_en: Killer Shell simulator (2 sessions included with the exam purchase)

subtitle_en: CKA training (Kubernetes v1.35): lessons following the official CNCF curriculum, labs on a real offline kubeadm cluster (controlplane + node01), exam-style tasks and a theory knowledge check.
